{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for refunded orders
num_refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')

# Check channel distribution
channel_counts = completed_df['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'Channel distribution: {channel_counts.to_dict()}')

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
customer_segment_by_channel = completed_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print(f'Customer segment distribution by channel: {customer_segment_by_channel.to_dict()}')"}
